senses.definition: (of a count noun) A huge and uncountable number of; too many to count; innumerable.
examples: There are countless stars in the sky.

quotes.text: He endured countless insults hurled at him before people finally respected him for his courage and his great ability as a baseball player.

examples: The stars in the sky are countless.

senses.definition: (of a number) Too large to be counted to.

quotes.text: Just stop and think deeply for a moment and realize the countless number of the grains of sand of the seashore; the countless number of drops of water that go to make up the waters of the earth; […]
